name: A Lost Master

meta.next: Escape Through Stealth or Escape Through Force

summary: In Darkshore, you follow Grimclaw’s trail to find the missing scout Volcor. You carry the Enchanted Moonstalker Cloak Terenthis made from fine moonstalker pelts.

sections.title: A Beacon in the Woods
sections.body: Terenthis in Auberdine has woven the Enchanted Moonstalker Cloak, and the search for Volcor begins. Grimclaw, the missing night elf scout’s loyal bear, waits on the road south of the settlement for help sent by Terenthis. Give Grimclaw a familiar greeting, and he leads you off the road toward the cave where Volcor is hiding.

sections.title: Hiding in the Dark
sections.body: Volcor lies wounded in a cavern after the corrupted furbolgs attacked him. He relies on stealth and Grimclaw’s wits to keep from being overrun. The enchanted cloak offers concealment and hope as he plans his escape, but his wounds leave him in danger on the journey back to Auberdine.

faq.answer: Volcor is a night elf scout from Darkshore who went missing near hostile furbolg encampments. After a confrontation left him badly wounded, he crawled into a nearby cave while his bear companion, Grimclaw, went for help.

faq.q: How do you find Volcor's hiding spot?
faq.answer: Grimclaw waits beside the road south of Auberdine. Wave to show you are the helper Terenthis sent, and Grimclaw runs toward the secluded cave where Volcor is hiding.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Enchanted Moonstalker Cloak?
faq.answer: Terenthis enchanted a cloak made from fine moonstalker pelts to grant brief, potent magical stealth. Its magic lets you pass Darkshore’s creatures as you search for Volcor, and you give the cloak to him.
Corrupted furbolg tribes roaming Darkshore ambushed and wounded Volcor. He escaped immediate slaughter, but his injuries kept him from returning to Auberdine alone.
After Volcor receives the enchanted cloak, he catches his breath and asks for your help escaping the wilderness. You can guide him out carefully through stealth or cut through the furbolgs by force.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see the bond between scouts and their animal companions in Grimclaw’s steadfast search for help for his master, Volcor.
As a hunter, you see the intelligence and devotion of Kalimdor’s well-trained beasts in the way Grimclaw finds help for Volcor.
As an Alliance member, you know Auberdine depends on scouts like Volcor to watch the growing corruption among Darkshore’s furbolg tribes, making his rescue vital to the outpost.
